title: Sensitivity as a sum of pivotal indicators
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The number of coordinates whose sign flip changes $f(x)$ equals the sum, over all coordinates, of the indicator that the coordinate is pivotal at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
